## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated if a reasonable test exists (tests use deck copies, never your real decks)
- [ ] Docs updated if users see a change (`README.md`, `README.ko.md`, `spec/`, `docs/CHANGELOG.md`)

- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
